title: Fire Watch

objectives.text: Night desk. A rumour about tonight.
Photograph the man with the cans
objectives.subject: npc.hired_firebug

objectives.text: A false alarm empties the lobby
Follow the firebug to whoever's paying
The firebug's crew turns on you
objectives.note: In the alley off W 31st; no fire is ever lit (content rule). Cops among the targets are ordinary killable police (heat only).

objectives.text: Catch the firebug on the W 31st roofs

then.doneOn: restrained, then o9 begins at the car

traversal.at: a dry-cleaner's rear fire escape off W 31st, ladder already down (he used it)
five landings up, past a window where an old man is watching the ballgame
over a skylight frame on the roof (don't step on the glass)
across a 1.5 m gap to the next walk-up, the firebug's gas can bouncing ahead
traversal.note: He drops the can; it rolls, leaking. Don't fire near it.

traversal.at: down a steel roof ladder to a lower setback roof
up onto a billboard catwalk, where he's cornered
traversal.note: Nowhere left to run: the catch.

objectives.traversalMobile: One context button (climb/vault), auto-aligned. No precise timing. A missed roof jump catches the ledge or drops to the fire-escape landing below. The quarry rubber-bands (never more than ~40 m ahead), so no timer fails the player.

objectives.text: Prentiss, in his car, with the money

fail.note: Wasted: retry from checkpoint (hospital flow, Gameplay).
Arrested: retry from checkpoint (booking flow, Gameplay).
Shown as '<Name> died'. Retry from checkpoint; offer a skip after repeated failures.

rewards.payNote: The tenants' collection and the Corwin's fire insurer's reward.

mobile: Content rule: **there's no fire.** Failing resets to the checkpoint. The false alarm brings real fire engines (ambience), and the tenants are walked out safely by Inez and Odessa. Inez's children are at her sister's (dialogue says so). Gus helps or hinders based on his relationship with Teddy (−3 means he leaves the service door open). The wait is a skippable time-advance.
design: Prentiss's plan, stopped. Delphine's photo plus the tail give Teddy leverage over Prentiss. The relationship gates from N3 §5 pay off visibly: Manny unlocks the service door at +3, and Gus at −3 is the risk. COMBAT (26 Nov): see COMBAT table in build_act23_missions.py.
conventions: FEATURE_AUDIT 'Mission conventions': cop kills feed heat only; 'Lose the police' gates on requireNoHeat objectives; fail only for standard reasons.
